scope: One static initial-scene illustration per release task. Backgrounds and task geometry come from the current benchmark sources. These images are not trajectories or success evidence.
notes: Fresh captures use the composed current USD scene through OpenUSD Storm with one bounded worker at a time; source geometry, transforms, authored cameras and backgrounds are retained.

Storm uses the authored scene lights with session-only intensity scaling and output-aspect camera aperture adjustments recorded per image; the additional camera headlight is disabled. Source USD files are unchanged.
Existing captures are reused after source-layer and texture hash checks, including recorded equivalent asset path relocations.
Capture images are cropped as recorded and resized to at most 960 by 640 pixels, then encoded as WebP.
The publication website can verify all 100 optimized images without simulator or benchmark access.
